relations.myth: Ahura Mazda prescribes rites for expelling Nasu
relations.note: Ahura Mazda explains Nasu’s attacks and teaches Zarathustra rites to expel her.
Middle Persian demonology places Nas within Ahriman’s hostile demonic creation.
Protective recitation invokes Sraoša against decay, death, and Nasu’s corpse-pollution.

relations.myth: Death produces the corpse polluted by Nas
relations.note: Astwihād seizes mortal life; Nas pollutes the resulting corpse without directly encountering him.

relations.myth: Nasu enters Gayōmard’s corpse after death
relations.note: Nasu enters primordial Gayōmard from his left little toe and moves upward.
